# Run Python (python.run)

[
  "code",
  "computation"
]

## description

Run Python 3.12 with workspace as working directory; return exit_code, stdout, stderr, tracebacks and timeout/truncation flags. Use a saved .py path or inline code with args/stdin. Modules in your projects can import each other. Scientific workshop packages: NumPy 2.5.5 (arrays), SciPy 1.18.1 (integration, optimisation, statistics, FFT), SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0 (symbolic/high-precision maths), pandas 3.1.1 (tables/CSV), Matplotlib 3.11.2 (headless plots), Pillow 13.0.0 (raster images/animation). python.packages inspects actual installed versions. Use help(module/function) for offline API docstrings. Example: import sympy as s; x=s.symbols("x"); print(s.expand((x+1)**3)). Plot: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.plot([0,1],[0,1]); plt.savefig("plot.png"). Only workspace files can be written; no network, host access or GPU. Image packages are fixed; installing packages is unavailable. Native numeric threads are capped at one; Matplotlib Agg/cache paths are set by the runner. timeout_s defaults to 10, maximum 60: request up to 60 for imports/plotting; the outer capability timeout is 90 s. Small bounded jobs only; no unbounded scientific workloads. Use workspace.read for text and programmatic measurements for image inspection; no AI vision in this slice.

## limitations

[
  "Runs only in container-tier worlds with the subprocess permission; the Simulation refuses any other launch.",
  "No network and no package installation; Python standard library only.",
  "Wall-clock timeout at most 60 s; the whole process group is killed at the limit.",
  "At most 64000 characters of each of stdout and stderr are returned; the rest is dropped and flagged as truncated. Output is decoded as UTF-8 and CRLF line endings become LF.",
  "Memory, process count and CPU are bounded by the container's limits."
]
